verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Kong serves a working llms.txt at developer.konghq.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing its documentation set for Gateway, Konnect, AI Gateway, and Mesh, directly matching the story of pointing an agent at an agent-oriented docs entrypoint. Missing for 10: no evidence of a more extensive llms-full.txt or additional per-product agent-doc indexes, and no independent (non-probe) commentary confirming real-world agent usage of this file.
